name: ambiguous_cleanup
title: Low-confidence intent: clarify before acting
description: The user's request is vague, so the planner proposes an archive it is not confident about. AgentGate does not send a guess to a human reviewer - it asks the user what they meant first. This is the ASK_USER path (PRD: 'low-confidence states').

steps.rationale: List inbox messages to work out what 'clean up' refers to
Planner cannot identify which messages should be archived because the request is ambiguous
